objective: Build Civic Agent Evaluation Harness with Scenario-Based Regression Suites (#1147)
acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Deliver documented architecture (ADR) and threat model including component boundaries, data-flow diagram, failure modes, operational ownership, performance/cost limits, accessibility, retention, licences, and migration/rollback guidance
AC-2: Implement core domain model and versioned API/event contracts under src/ai/evals/ and api/_lib/ with strict untrusted input validation at service boundaries

AC-3: Implement synthetic scenario suites (core, jurisdiction, refusal, adversarial, multilingual), deterministic scoring (task success, factuality, citation coverage, refusal correctness, prohibited outcomes, latency), redacted trace storage, model/version comparison, and release threshold gates

AC-4: Provide an end-to-end vertical slice integrated with Civic Help Setu's real agent/gateway pipelines, backend API (/api/civic-agent-eval), reproducible CLI command (npm run eval:harness), and evaluation report
AC-5: Provide an accessible Admin UI panel integrated into src/pages/Admin.jsx with human-approval boundary notices and zero-PII guarantees
AC-6: Deliver unit, integration, and E2E tests covering negative, concurrency, retry, redaction, and permission-boundary cases, passing ESLint/security lint and Vitest
non_goals: Do not claim official government integration, verification, legal authority, or guaranteed outcomes
Do not store or expose real citizen records, PII, credentials, or private documents in logs, prompts, traces, or analytics
No autonomous filing, benefit denial, or official-status claims
